visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with auburn hair tied back in pigtails stands in a brightly lit indoor living room. She holds a large, flat plastic package featuring cartoon characters. She smiles broadly, looking at the camera and then at the package. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban street during the day. A hand holds the same plastic package against a backdrop of city buildings and a clear sky. The packaging is reflective under the natural light. (3) Back indoors, the camera focuses on a white table. The woman's hands, with manicured brown nails, begin detaching perforated paper pieces from a large sheet. The pieces have illustrated facial features of a white cartoon character. (4) The woman holds a partially assembled white paper head, folding along pre-scored lines. She demonstrates the folding technique with her fingers, showing the 3D structure forming. (5) Hands press together tabs on a beige-colored paper base shaped like a car. The base features a smiling bear-like face. Various small paper components like black circles for wheels are shown on the white table. (6) The woman attaches the four black paper wheels to the side of the beige car base. She looks at the camera with an expression of surprise and delight, holding the rolling car. (7) A close-up shows hands carefully folding a small white paper tab. The woman then inserts the white cartoon character's head into the top of the beige car base. (8) The woman holds an orange paper handle and attaches it to the assembly. She then shows a small, round plastic LED light unit, turning it on to reveal a green glow before placing it inside the paper structure. (9) In a final indoor shot, she holds the completed lantern, which is now glowing. The scene then cuts to a night shot of the lantern on the ground, then to the woman walking in a large public plaza at night, carrying the glowing lantern and gesturing toward it.
